name: Simulate Renin Angiotensin System Dynamics
description: Simulate the time-dependent concentrations of renin-angiotensin system (RAS) components.
detailed_description: Simulate the time-dependent concentrations of renin-angiotensin system (RAS) components.
when_to_use: When you need simulate renin angiotensin system dynamics analysis

parameters.initial_concentrations: [Required] Initial concentrations of RAS components with keys: 'renin', 'angiotensinogen', 'angiotensin_I', 'angiotensin_II', 'ACE2_angiotensin_II', 'angiotensin_1_7' (dict)
parameters.feedback_params: [Required] Parameters controlling feedback mechanisms with keys: 'fb_ang_II', 'fb_ace2' (dict)
parameters.time_points: [Optional] Number of time points to evaluate (default: 100)
